name: travel-plan-viz
title_zh: 离线可读的手机旅行页，地图时间轴订票提醒一页装完
tagline_zh: 到了当地没网、翻聊天记录找攻略最抓狂。它出单文件 HTML：交互地图 + 每日时间轴 + 出发前订票提醒，存手机上离线可读。
tagline_en: The worst moment abroad is standing on a corner with no data, scrolling chat history for the plan. It emits one HTML file: interactive map, day-by-day timeline, pre-departure booking reminders — saved to your phone, readable offline.
desc_en: 把旅行行程做成美观、离线可读、手机优先的单文件 HTML（交互地图+每日时间轴+出发前订票提醒）。两种用法——只给目的地和天数让它帮你规划，或丢一份现成计划让它直接出页面。触发：旅行计划可视化、做旅行攻略网页、行程 HTML、travel plan visualization。
why_zh: 「离线可读、手机优先、单文件」——这三个约束是真在国外用过才想得到的，不是坐在电脑前设计出来的。
why_en: Offline-readable, phone-first, single file. Those three constraints only occur to someone who has actually needed them abroad.
limit_zh: 地图引的是 Leaflet CDN，所谓「离线可读」保得住文字和时间轴，地图那块断网就是空的。实时票价、代订票、多语言、后端，作者在「不做」一节里明写一概不做。最后那步校验要本机有 node 跑 assets/validate.js。
limit_en: The map is a Leaflet CDN embed, so 'offline' holds for the text and timeline but the map goes blank. Live fares, booking, multi-language and any backend are listed under what it deliberately does not do.
title_en: Offline mobile travel page: map, timeline, booking alerts.
